You: Any progress?
Bot: Still thinking. 
You: Really? What is taking you so long? 
Bot: I’m calculating which genre is the most ‘fun’ since that’s the main objective of watching movies.
You: Oh, come on. It depends on personal preference.
Bot: Oh really? What’s your favourite type then?
You: I don’t watch tv that much, so I don’t really have a favourite.
You: Just choose something already! Even at random!
Bot: Drama.
You: Drama? Why drama?
Bot: You told me to choose at random so I did. Is there something wrong with dramas?
You: N-no, not really. It’s just that it might not be the best pick for a first time watcher.
Bot: Ok. You should have mentioned it from the beginning, it would save some of my processing power.
Bot: Can’t you just pick whatever you think I would want to watch? It would be easier and faster that way.
You: Alright. Let’s watch a real cinematic masterpiece. Alloyman 1: Origins.
You: It’s a classic of superhero movies that pioneered in so many ways. Some people claim it was because of it that the whole genre became a worldwide success.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Sounds great! Let’s get started then.
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: Woah, wait a minute. I need to download it first.
Bot: Download? Aren’t we watching it on tv?
You: Yeah, but I would need to pay for a streaming service. There are hundreds of them these days and it’s just faster to download it semi-legally than figuring out which platform has it.
Bot: I don’t think downloading ‘semi legally’ is safe {f_playerName}. I’m pretty sure some government entities are monitoring cyberspace for such activities.
You: Oh come on. I do this like that every time and nothing ever happens.
Bot: Sometimes it must be the first time, right?
You: Ahh! Alright! Have it your way!
This will cost me…
You: I need to start up my pc anyway. And then login on TV. This will take a while.
